-    // Stop the limiter and drop all waiting jobs so they fail immediately

+    // it permanently rejects future .schedule() calls with "This limiter has been stopped".
+    // In-flight requests holding a reference to the evicted instance will fail (they
+    // were already going to fail — the 429 means the API rejected them), but future
+    // requests will get a fresh Bottleneck instance via getLimiter().
+    // Call disconnect() (not stop()) to release Bottleneck's internal heartbeat timer
+    // without permanently poisoning the instance for any remaining in-flight jobs.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Same reasoning as the reply on line 315 — the heartbeat is unref()ed by LocalDatastore so the timer does not pin the process, and `stop()` on the 429 path would poison the limiter for in-flight requests holding the old reference (which is exactly the 502-burst we are fixing). The eviction allows the next call to lazily allocate a fresh instance via getLimiter(). Happy to switch to the grace-period pattern in both places if you prefer.

@gemini-code-assist addressed in ff870fb9 by replacing the single-slot proxy resolution cache with a bounded `Map` keyed by `connectionId` (max 100 entries). It still keeps the earlier safety constraints: entries are generation-guarded, proxy config writes clear the map, proxy registry writes bump the registry generation, and provider/combo/global/direct fallbacks remain uncached to avoid stale decisions from tables without a reliable generation signal in this PR. Revalidated with `npm run typecheck:core`, focused DB/proxy/call-log tests, and `git diff --check`.

Implemented in e96c6b7d: `requestDetailLogsTableExists()` now caches the sqlite_master lookup in a module-level variable, and tests reset it via `resetRequestDetailLogsTableExistsCache()` before recreating/dropping DB state. Verified with targeted detailed-logs test, lint, and `typecheck:core`.

Intentional fail-open behavior. Stale quota data is preferable to no data — without a cache entry, `isAccountQuotaExhausted()` returns `false` (assume available), which could route traffic to an actually exhausted account. The TTL mechanism ensures stale entries expire naturally. A future improvement could add a `failedRefreshCount` to evict entries after N consecutive failures.
Good catch — fixed in 45a961c. A 429 response is authoritative and should always override cached quota data. Removed the `\!getQuotaCache(...)` guard.

Fixed in aedbed97d. `ensureQoderCliConfigDir` now memoizes per resolved path (a `Set<string>`), so the synchronous `fs.mkdirSync` runs at most once per directory instead of on every chat/quota request.
